transcript: If you are not making 1 lakh a month, you should not be allowed to do these 5 things. Number 1, have a girlfriend. Instead of spending 10,000 rupees and wasting 2 days of your life every weekend, pick up a side hustle and start making more money. If you want a list of side hustles and how to do them, comment 1 lakh and I will share it with you. Number 2, going to the gym. Roz tum 2 ghanta gym me jaake apne muscles ko pump kar rahe ho, but it is a fake sense of achievement. Your life is still same as before. You are still broke. Number 3, celebrating festivals. India me har 15 din me festival aata hai and 1 festival ke piche minimum 5 days barbaad hote hai. That is 10 days of the month gone for empty dopamine. Number 5, watching cricket. Every year Indian cricketers play in 100+ matches including IPL. Tum wo saare ke saare dekhte ho. They are getting richer and you are getting poorer while you watch them. Think about that. Number 5, watching Netflix. Tum 6 ghanta kisi aur ko main character hote hue dekh rahe ho, but tum apni life me sirf ek side character ho. Isse accha comment 1 lakh and I will tell you all the side hustles and teach you how to do them.
caption: Comment “1 Lakh” & i’ll share all the side hustles and how you can make money from them
